newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Net sales of 120,800 MT were down 44 percent from the prior week, but improved 2 percent from the 4-week average.

The major buyers were Mexico (68,000 MT, reflects 99,700 new sales, 31,700 cancellations) and Japan (50,200 MT, reflects 45,000 new sales, 7,300 destination changes, 2,100 cancellations). Decreases of 12,300 MT were reported for unknown destinations.
Exports of 60,500 MT were one-third below the previous week and 43 percent under the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Mexico (21,800 MT) and Japan (15,700 MT).
